title: Split after 1st use 🐝
text: Split after 1st use 🐝. 🐝 I made soft marzipan candy in these and when I popped them out, I noticed that the mold had split in several places. I included a picture with my review so you can see the weak spots.  I wish it was more durable. The design is darling. And after the bees came out, the detail is spot on and easy to identify. The mold cleaned up perfectly. I loved using this but am disappointed that it may not last long.
